browser.empty: Amakhasi avuleka lapha, eceleni kwengxoxo, ukuze ubuke ngenkathi nikhuluma.
browser.blank: Ikhasi alibonakali? Amanye amasayithi awavumeli ukuboniswa ngaphakathi kwelinye.
browser.own.title: Isayithi {site} ivuleka kuthebhu yayo
browser.own.text: Amanye amasayithi awakwazi ukuboniswa eceleni kwengxoxo: awakuvumeli, noma i-akhawunti yakho isebenza kuthebhu yawo kuphela.
browser.install: Uyisebenzisa kaningi? Yifake njenge-app: ithola iwindi layo nendawo kudeskithophu yakho, futhi isebenza lapho ngendlela okufanele.
browser.install.chrome: Ku-Chrome: vula isayithi, bese imenyu ⋮, Cast, save and share, bese Install page as app.
browser.install.edge: Ku-Edge: vula isayithi, bese imenyu …, Apps, bese Install this site as an app.
browser.install.safari: Ku-Safari: vula isayithi, bese File, bese Add to Dock.
browser.install.phone: Efonini: vula isayithi, bese Share noma imenyu, bese Add to Home Screen.
browser.install.other: Esipheqululini sakho: vula isayithi, bese ubheka kumenyu yaso okuthi Install noma Create shortcut.
browser.install.none: Lesi siphequluli asikwazi ukufaka amasayithi njengama-app: gcina isayithi kumabhukhimakhi akho esikhundleni salokho.
browser.build: Ikhasi {page} alikwazi ukubonakala njengoba linjalo: ifayela {file} kufanele lakhiwe kuqala, ngamathuluzi angasebenzi esipheqululini. Cela ikhasi elisebenza njengoba linjalo.
browser.shut: Isiphequluli sakho asivumelanga ukuvula ifolda {folder}. Layisha kabusha ukuze ubuze futhi.
